items.title: Bank Of America (BAC) Joins Clash Over Fed GSIB Capital Rule
items.summary: Bank of America (NYSE:BAC) and other major US banks are publicly disputing the Federal Reserve's proposed revision to the GSIB capital surcharge for large institutions. The clash centers on how the updated surcharge would affect required capital buffers for the biggest banks and the rules that govern those calculations.
